sentences.en: At the end of the speech she repeated the word.
sentences.zh: 在演讲结束时，她重复了那个单词。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever repeated a year.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次重读一年。

sentences.en: Because of Sami's repeated infidelities, Layla decided to move out.
sentences.zh: 由于萨米一再的不忠行为，莱拉决定搬出去。
